correctness.rationale: Definitions are consistent: arcs of fully bidirected simple graph, faces are directed vertex-disjoint simple paths including augmented empty face, no directed 2-cycles. Independently enumerated all 2^(n choose 2) labelled graphs at n<=5 up to permutation, 52 isomorphism types with counts (1,2,4,11,34). Rebuilt each multipath complex from direct arc-subset combinations and acyclicity tests, and independently computed exact integer Smith normal forms of every ordinary boundary with SymPy over ZZ. Across all 52 classes, the ONLY nonunit Smith factor is 2 for n=5 mask 127 (orbit size 10), at boundary degree two. Witness nonempty face numbers (14,54,60,12), boundary ranks (13,41,12) and factor 2 imply reduced H1=Z/2, H2=Z^7, nothing else. Checked direct chain condition d1 d2=d2 d3=0 on the witness. The source code additionally checks two distinct fully Hasse-acyclic Morse matchings with residual entries (2,2,2) and (2,-2); no hidden infinite extrapolation is needed for this finite theorem.
